channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 14
item.description:
62 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to the safezone.
  • Squirrels no longer wander into riverside or oceanside water areas.
  • Fence gate opening/closing speed halved for smoother operation; trough colliders fixed and water containers now emit sounds.

Animals & AI

  • Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to the safezone.
  • Squirrels no longer wander into riverside or oceanside water areas.
  • Critter animal hitboxes (e.g., frogs, squirrels) have been fixed.
  • Multiple animals near a vehicle now interact correctly.

Fencing & Structures

  • Fence gate opening/closing speed halved for smoother operation; trough colliders fixed and water containers now emit sounds.
  • Fence colliders restored, gates now have controller sockets and refined lock positions; fences can be demolished with a hammer and show a blue highlight when demolishable.

Tools & Input

  • Salvaged cleaver reach distance corrected.
  • Key‑binding and key‑latching bugs fixed, preventing menu closure issues with gamepads and accidental console opening.

Cooking

  • Raw beef now cooks correctly after adding the missing becomeOnCooked reference.
  • New meat types added to all oven prefabs, expanding cooking options.

AI Mounting

  • Generation 2 AI can now be mounted via a new NPCMountable component; entities parent directly to the mount (temporary teleport mount animation).

UI & Store

  • Store backgrounds now correctly generate blurhash sprites, fixing missing or incorrect colors on store pages.
